jobs.title: ASP.Net & Sitecore Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Description
Datacube Consultancy & Solutions is a leading IT services company headquartered in Abu Dhabi, UAE, with an offshore delivery center in India. The organization is known for delivering cutting-edge information technology services that are client-focused, efficient, affordable, and on time. Datacube has strong capabilities in implementing and supporting ERP applications, data management services, and advanced analytics for both large enterprises and SMEs. The company provides consulting and IT services across a diversified range of industries, offering opportunities to work on complex and varied business challenges. Team members collaborate in a dynamic environment focused on high-quality delivery and long-term client partnerships.

Role Description

We are looking for an experienced ASP.Net & Sitecore Engineer
to join the Information Technology – Service Delivery
team of a leading banking organization in Abu Dhabi.

Key Requirements • 7–10 years
of experience in Sitecore implementation & support

• Strong hands-on experience with Sitecore CMS – Sitecore 10 / XM Cloud

• Experience with C#, ASP.NET, MVC, .NET Core, Razor, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, jQuery & T-SQL

• Strong knowledge of Sitecore SXA, JSS, Headless, Forms & Cortex

• Experience with Sitecore Search & SOLR Search

• Hands-on experience with Sitecore JSS, React & Next.js

• Experience with Sitecore xDB & personalization

• Knowledge of Web API, Sitecore packages, publishing, workflows & custom fields

• Experience with Azure deployment
is a strong advantage
• Experience with Unicorn/TDS
is a plus
• Sitecore 10 XP Developer Certification
is an advantage
• Experience in Sitecore 10 → XM Cloud migration
and Sitecore AI
is preferred
• Strong understanding of Agile development & SDLC

What You'll Do ✔ Develop and maintain Sitecore solutions based on business requirements
✔ Design and maintain key Sitecore components
✔ Integrate Sitecore with other enterprise systems
✔ Troubleshoot, track and resolve application issues
✔ Prepare technical documentation, test cases and release documentation
✔ Coordinate with QA and development teams
✔ Build POCs and implement Sitecore best practices
✔ Support application administration in non-production environments
✔ Conduct knowledge transfer to support teams

We’re looking for someone who is technically strong, collaborative, detail-oriented and comfortable working in a banking/enterprise technology environment.

jobs.title: Fullstack Engineer
jobs.description:
At DraftKings, AI is becoming an integral part of both our present and future, powering how work gets done today, guiding smarter decisions, and sparking bold ideas. It’s transforming how we enhance customer experiences, streamline operations, and unlock new possibilities. Our teams are energized by innovation and readily embrace emerging technology. We’re not waiting for the future to arrive. We’re shaping it, one bold step at a time. To those who see AI as a driver of progress, come build the future together.

The Crown Is Yours

As a Fullstack Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in the expansion of our enterprise software platform—an ecosystem of microservices that manages casino gameplay operations and financial transactions, featuring high-performing APIs that deliver content to end users. Our engineering division is composed of many tight-knit and stable teams that each own a specific area of our platform all the way from the UI to the database. Joining our Casino Platform team you'll sharpen your skills alongside experienced engineers in a team that delivers fast and builds with intention.

What You'll Do as a Fullstack Engineer:

Contribute to fullstack feature development in close collaboration with senior engineers.
Write clean, reliable, and well-tested code that supports scalable systems.
Join architecture and design discussions to understand tradeoffs and priorities.
Deploy applications on AWS platforms.
Use observability tools to troubleshoot issues and monitor system health.
Support deployment and on-call workflows to ensure reliability of team-owned systems.
Apply feedback, ask thoughtful questions, and continuously grow your skills.
Work as part of a team that prioritizes speed, quality, and continuous learning.

What You'll Bring

Bachelor's degree in computer science or any suitable combination of education, experience, and training.
At least 2 yearс of experience as a Software Engineer using languages such as C#, ASP.NET (.NET 8+), React, and TypeScript.
Understanding of PostgreSQL and MySQL databases.
Strong foundation in object-oriented programming, design patterns, and core algorithms.
Confidence working across both front-end and back-end layers in distributed, cloud-based architectures.
Curiosity about how systems work under the hood and an interest in architecture beyond your own code.
A sense of ownership, a willingness to ask for help, and the drive to keep improving your craft.
Agile methodology experience is an advantage.

Join Our Team

We’re a publicly traded (NASDAQ: DKNG) technology company headquartered in Boston. As a regulated gaming company, you may be required to obtain a gaming license issued by the appropriate state agency as a condition of employment. Don’t worry, we’ll guide you through the process if this is relevant to your role.
